basic_profile.bio: I'm a recent graduate from a small college in the Midwest, currently living in Duluth. I work as a freelance graphic designer and spend my free time exploring video games, especially RPGs like Shadow of Mordor. I'm a night owl, often online during late-night hours. I'm single and enjoy discovering new hobbies and communities on Reddit. I'm quite new to Reddit and still figuring out how everything works.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor’s degree in graphic design, and I've taught myself various design software tools through online courses and YouTube tutorials. My knowledge of gaming comes from years of playing various genres and following gaming news.
